segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בַּעַל אוֹב – זֶה פִּיתוֹם הַמְדַבֵּר מִשֶּׁחְיוֹ, וְיִדְּעוֹנִי – זֶה הַמְדַבֵּר בְּפִיו. הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ בִּסְקִילָה, וְהַנִּשְׁאָל בָּהֶם בְּאַזְהָרָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» The list of those liable to be executed by stoning includes those who practice various types of sorcery. The mishna describes them: «A necromancer is a pitom from whose armpit» the voice of the dead appears to «speak. And a sorcerer is» one «from whose mouth» the dead appears to «speak. These,» the necromancer and the sorcerer, «are» executed «by stoning, and one who inquires» about the future «through them is in» violation of «a prohibition.»

moves.cueHe: בעל אוב – זה פיתום המדבר משחיו
moves.summary: defines ov and yidde'oni and assigns stoning; inquirer under a prohibition

positions.claim: the ov and yidde'oni are stoned; one who inquires of them transgresses a prohibition
